subject: POC planning & final readout scheduling - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap & POC plan (next steps)

Thanks Samantha — great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the POC:

- Scope: Validate Redwood Inference integration for clinical note generation and indexed embeddings for search across a 30K patient-note dataset.
- Success criteria (proposed): 1) average generation latency < 350ms for 512-token responses under 50 concurrent users; 2) embedding recall > 0.88 on the sample eval set; 3) no PHI exfiltration in logs (we'll support with audit log config).
- Evaluation plan: 2-week sandbox POC, 1 week for onboarding (data ingest + SSO), 1 week for eval and readout.
- Owners: Marcus (AE) — program/exec coordination; Marissa (Solutions) — technical onboarding & eval harness; Rishi (Customer Success) — run the final readout and adoption plan.
- Open asks for you: confirm success criteria above, provide sample eval dataset access (S3 link or shared Drive), and confirm stakeholder list for the final readout (execs + technical).

I've attached the draft POC plan (20270220-acme-poc-plan.pdf) and a template for success criteria (acme-success-criteria.xlsx) — please review and share any edits.

Proposing timelines: onboarding week starts Feb 22; final readout 1-week window of Feb 28 — Marcus will coordinate exec availability once you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-health.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Miller <jason.miller@acme-health.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & POC plan (next steps)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear plan and owners. Quick answers from our side: 

- Success criteria: +1 to your proposed KPIs. A couple of notes: please add a secondary metric for hallucination rate on a 200-sample clinical QA set (<5% unacceptable answers). Also we need per-request audit logging to an S3 bucket we control.
- Dataset: we'll share a scrubbed 5K-note sample to the S3 bucket by EOD Friday (shared with marissa.cole@redwood.com).
- Stakeholders: Myself (Samantha, Dir. of Clinical Informatics), Jason Miller (CTO), and Karen Diaz (VP Product) will join the final readout. Procurement will loop in their counterparty for contract next steps once we get a positive readout.

We can confirm onboarding week of Feb 22 but need the SSO/SCIM setup instructions and a quick runbook for data ingestion to avoid delays. Attached: updated success criteria (acme-success-criteria.xlsx) with the hallucination metric and logging requirements.

—
Samantha Lee
Director, Clinical Informatics
Acme Health
samantha.lee@acme-health.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap & POC plan (next steps) — action items for onboarding

Looping you all in — Samantha confirmed success criteria and the need for SSO/SCIM and per-request audit logging to their S3. Key asks for our side: 

1) Marissa: lead technical onboarding (SSO/SCIM instructions, data ingest runbook). Can you confirm we can have an onboarding checklist by EOD Monday (Feb 22)?
2) Rishi: you'll own the final readout demo and exec narrative — can you draft a 20-min readout agenda and confirm presenter(s) (we should include product + CS)?
3) Neha: procurement questions may come through — can you be the contact to escalate contract framing & early SOW items?

We should confirm final readout slot this week (Samantha suggested the week of Feb 28). If we aim for Feb 28 10:00 PT for a 30-45 minute exec readout, does that look feasible?

I'll prepare the SOW/DocuSign template once we get a preliminary go/no-go signal after the readout.

—
Marcus
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap & POC plan (next steps) — onboarding checklist

Thanks Marcus. Confirming owners & immediate deliverables: 

- Onboarding checklist: I will share a completed onboarding runbook and SSO/SCIM setup guide by 2027-02-22T17:00-08:00. That will include steps for: S3 credentials, data schema expectations, ingestion script examples, and instructions for enabling per-request audit logs. Attachment: redwood-poc-sla.docx (runbook + SLA notes).
- Eval harness: I'll spin up the sample eval harness (embedding + retrieval eval notebook) and share Drive link for the team by Feb 24.
- Final readout agenda draft: Rishi — can you confirm the 20-min agenda (10-min demo, 8-min metrics/QA, 2-min next steps) and who will present metrics?

We should also prepare a 1-pager for execs that summarizes success criteria and go/no-go gating so Procurement knows the expected contract deliverable. I'll draft that and share prior to the readout.

—
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Onboarding checklist & readout timing — Feb 28 confirmed

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Week-of availability confirmed and Feb 28 at 10:00 AM PT works for Jason and me for the final readout. Karen Diaz is tentatively available; I will confirm by Thursday. Procurement asked that we clarify the expected contract step after a positive readout — ideally an SOW with estimated monthly committed capacity. They asked for a placeholder range so they can prepare internally.

Please include a 1-pager for execs with the exact go/no-go criteria and an estimated post-POC pricing slide (range is fine).

—
Samantha
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-02-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final readout on Feb 28 — agenda & next contract step

Confirmed for Feb 28, 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite to follow. Agenda (20-30 mins):

1) Quick customer context & success criteria (Samantha) — 3 mins
2) Product demo: generation + retrieval pipeline (Marissa) — 10 mins
3) Metrics & evaluation results (Rishi) — 7 mins
4) Go/no-go decision criteria & next steps (Marcus) — 5 mins

Post-readout contract step: if the execs sign off, we'll send a draft SOW outlining 3-month pilot terms and a placeholder committed capacity range. Neha will coordinate with Procurement on any redlines and the DocuSign flow.

Attachments for the readout: acme-success-criteria.xlsx, redwood-poc-sla.docx, 20270220-acme-poc-plan.pdf
